messages:
jane_acme (AcmeCorp): Hi, since the 08:15 canary rollout our assistant started dropping system instructions mid-conversation. We had a hard rule in the system prompt: always ask for account_id and never expose internal links. After ~2.1k tokens the model stops following that rule and begins hallucinating. Request id: req_0a1b2c3d. Model seen: redwood-llm-v2.1-optim. Payload token estimate ~11k. Output seems truncated/coherence drops, but API returns 200.

lee_support: Sorry about that — cc'ing eng + sre. Can you share a minimal repro (sanitized) and the full request headers so we can trace the request id?

jane_acme (AcmeCorp): Pasting a shortened sanitized curl below (system prompt intentionally long). Note: we observe the behaviour consistently on multi-turn sessions with long system + history.

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{
    "model": "redwood-llm-v2.1-optim",
    "conversation": {
      "system_prompt": "<LONG SYSTEM PROMPT - contains strict instruction to always ask for account_id, never reveal internal links, and validation rules> ... (2.5k tokens)",
      "messages": [
        {"role": "user", "content": "Hey assistant, help me generate a billing summary for account 12345"},
        {"role": "assistant", "content": "Acknowledged. Please confirm account_id."},
        {"role": "user", "content": "Here is the full history... (several previous turns)"}
      ],
      "max_history_tokens": 12000
    },
    "max_tokens": 512
  }'
```

devon_eng: We started receiving alerts around that time. Confirming: a canary to redwood-llm-v2.1-optim rolled at 2026-03-15T08:15 UTC (deploy id dply-6789). @deploy-bot posted the event. Hypothesis: the new execution path/quantization kernel reduces the effective KV cache headroom which causes prefix/system prompt eviction earlier than before.

deploy-bot: Deployment redwood-llm-v2.1-optim rolled to canary at 2026-03-15T08:15 by aj_prod (id: dply-6789).

maria_sre: Observed metrics: KV eviction rate on eu-west-1-g2 pool jumped from ~0.5% to ~6% post-rollout. Memory pressure increased on several pods, and p95 latency +120ms. Sample node log snippet:

```
2026-03-15T08:18:23Z node-12 kernel: kv_cache_evict key=conv-abc size=3245 reason=cache_pressure
2026-03-15T08:18:23Z node-12 serve: request=req_0a1b2c3d model=redwood-llm-v2.1-optim tokens_in=11000 tokens_out=2100
```

devon_eng: Can we repro locally by running the new kernel with smaller KV size and the same long system prompt? @maria_sre, can you attach the memory/kv config used in canary? Also asking customer to try pinning to v2.0-stable to confirm regression is rollout-related.

lee_support: @jane_acme could you try forcing the header `X-Prefer-Model-Variant: redwood-llm-v2.0-stable` or set `"model": "redwood-llm-v2.0-stable"` in the request and report back? Also try adding `"conversation": { "kv_enabled": true }` if possible.

jane_acme (AcmeCorp): Tried pinning to v2.0-stable and the instruction persisted across the same multi-turn sample — behaviour reverted to expected. With v2.1-optim the system prompt gets cut around ~2.1k tokens; with v2.0-stable it stays.

aj_prod: Pausing further canary expansion. @devon_eng please prepare rollback plan + hotfix. Also open an internal ticket to investigate kernel/quantization impact on KV/cache capacity. If this is a regression we need an RCA and a remediation timeline.

devon_eng: Will do. Immediate mitigation: restrict canary to 1% traffic and add an automatic rollback trigger if KV eviction rate > 2% or instruction-drop reports > 5/min. Ticket created: INF-1234 (repro steps, logs, sample payload). Repro steps saved in ticket and local harness updated.

maria_sre: For customers impacted right now we can: 1) pin to redwood-llm-v2.0-stable, 2) reduce `max_history_tokens` to keep prefix in active KV window, or 3) temporarily route them to dedicated pool with larger KV memory. We'll coordinate with support to apply per-customer routing until fix ships.

lee_support: Thanks all. @jane_acme we'll keep you updated and can toggle routing/pinning for you if you'd like us to do that. Closing loop for now and will follow up with RCA once engineering confirms root cause. :thumbsup:

jane_acme (AcmeCorp): Appreciate the quick response. Pinning helped and temporary routing would be great while you work on the fix.
